purpose: Allow complete user help while preventing proprietary implementation, custom mathematics, proof internals, secrets, and source architecture from being exposed.
forbidden_content: parameter defaults unless separately marked public
raw module assumptions/limitations if they reveal proprietary method details
private repository layout beyond public help paths
custom CACE equations or proprietary mathematical derivations
proof artifact hashes or private qualification artifacts
public_rigor_topics: metadata does not equal executed evidence
formal claims require separate canonical qualification
provenance identifies results but does not prove mathematics
connection_rule: Connection suggestions are based only on public port type/unit compatibility. Compatibility means the data contract can connect; it does not by itself establish that the scientific experiment is appropriate.
